customer_name: Hangzhou Quanzhen Medical Technology Co., Ltd.
business_problem: Quanzhen Medical needed a strong Chinese foundation model, an integrated training-and-inference toolchain and a private-delivery path so it could commercialize large-model healthcare applications for hospitals with high data-security requirements.
solution_summary: Quanzhen Medical and Baidu AI Cloud built a two-path healthcare large-model delivery architecture around ERNIE Speed and the Qianfan platform. In the public-cloud path, Quanzhen trains and validates its domain model on Qianfan so new clinical scenarios can be tested quickly. In the private path, Baidu supplies the servers and training-inference software for a joint all-in-one appliance, while Quanzhen contributes the healthcare large model and delivers the combined system into hospitals that need stronger data control. The resulting platform supports electronic medical-record generation, pre-consultation note creation and other clinical language tasks rather than just acting as a demo chatbot. Because the model stack is wrapped with both public-cloud and appliance delivery modes, Quanzhen can serve county-level organizations and tertiary hospitals from the same product family while keeping the clinical language model, tuning loop and deployment tooling consistent.

solution_components.name: Qianfan ModelBuilder
solution_components.role: Supports model training, tuning and evaluation for Quanzhen's healthcare large model.

solution_components.name: Qianfan AppBuilder
solution_components.role: Packages healthcare application workflows on top of the model stack.

solution_components.name: ERNIE Speed
solution_components.role: Provides the Chinese foundation model used to build Quanzhen's clinical AI services.

solution_components.name: Joint All-in-One Appliance
solution_components.role: Delivers the private hospital deployment path for security-sensitive customers.

data_flow: Clinical data and language tasks are processed through the Quanzhen healthcare model on Qianfan or the private appliance, which generates EMR drafts and pre-consultation records and returns them to hospital workflows.
business_outcome: Quanzhen created a healthcare-specific large-model product line that improves medical documentation speed and quality while supporting both public-cloud and private hospital delivery.
metrics: Electronic medical records can be generated in 2-3 seconds.
